title: Topic 14
japanese_text: 最寄り駅の周りは<u>墓地</u>があるだけで、いつも<u>人け</u>がない。最近、駅前の<u>駐輪場</u>に不審者が出ているらしい。だから、今日はいつもと違う<u>ルート</u>で<u>遠回りして</u>帰宅するつもりだ。
english_translation: Around my nearest station, there's only a cemetery and there are never any signs of human presence. Recently, a suspicious person seems to be hanging around the bicycle parking lot in front of the station. So I'm going to detour by taking a different route home today.
